decisions.reason: The data processing agreement tool fits the firm's agency and compliance focus, kept its own page in 2024, and drew positive customer feedback, so it meets the aspiration and gives no trigger for problemistic search.
As the flagship platform shown on the home page in both years, it carries the firm's strategic direction and is very unlikely to be dropped.

The configurable managed hosting plan sits at the core of the established business and stays on its own page, and the industry is growing, so there is enough slack and no shortfall to justify dropping it.

Extended PHP security support is cheap to maintain and serves customers on legacy PHP versions, though it has only a minor web presence and may be reshaped as PHP versions reach end of life, which leaves it somewhat more exposed than the other products.
